entries.short_description: Oct 2026 arXiv: resource-layer defense where an isolated-context digital twin learns user-specific least-privilege policies and answers the agent's permission requests as the user's proxy; complements tool-call auto-mode classifiers.
entries.title: Pincer: Resource Authorization for Agents using a Digital Twin

entries.short_description: Oct 2026 arXiv: harness optimizer that also evolves its own tools/skills/hooks, gated by execution-based verification; best harness 42.3% held-out SWE-rebench and 37.7% OOD (5 languages) vs 39.2% / 29.3% strongest baselines.
entries.title: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses

entries.short_description: Oct 2026 arXiv: defines User-conditioned Relational Agent Memory (how this agent should work with this user) beside user facts; 3,065 episodes / 50,961 sessions / 61,210 QA; Full-Pipeline QA drops sharply vs Gold-Memory, low Capture recall and unsafe deletion across 20 models.
entries.title: DyadMem: A Long-Term Memory Benchmark of How Agents Work with Users

entries.short_description: LiteTrajEval: offline domain rule profiles + deterministic budget serialization + single rubric-guided LLM judge. Improves failure-localization alignment ~20–35pp vs AgentRx on Magentic-One; ~6× cheaper / >8× faster under same judge. Deployed in enterprise agentic platform.
entries.title: arXiv LiteTrajEval: Budget-Bounded Trajectory Evaluation (2610.03315)

entries.short_description: Task–harness co-evolution (RSI): online + post-task harness updates with candidate gate; fixed weights/verifier. Solver acc 100%→54.8% over 14 rounds; Full beats Task-only by 23.5pp. 27B SFT on 10K synth math → 62.5% APEX mean-16. Complements VERSE/ScholarEvolve.
entries.title: arXiv Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Reasoning Data Synthesis (2610.03548)

entries.short_description: DepGPO redistributes GRPO advantages via command read–write dependency graphs traced to verifier-inspected resources. Beats strongest RL baseline by 3.2–10.0pp pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0/2.1 (Qwen3.5-9B / 3.6-27B × SETA/TMAX); more stable late training than GRPO/GiGPO.
entries.title: arXiv DepGPO: Dependency-Aware Credit for Terminal Agents (2610.03634)

entries.short_description: OpenAI Oct 5: textGrain text watermark — EU ChatGPT/Codex outputs watermarked in coming weeks, global API opt-in today (off by default), detector limited to approved researchers; no quality loss on Astra benches, but weak on short/edited/math text.
entries.title: OpenAI: Our approach to EU text provenance rules (textGrain watermark)

entries.short_description: OpenAI Oct 5: new visual ad format tested during ChatGPT image generation (US, later in Oct), Conversions API + attribution partners (AppsFlyer, Triple Whale, Northbeam…), incrementality pilots, Negative Phrases and DV/IAS brand-suitability pilots; ChatGPT at 1.2B weekly users.
entries.title: OpenAI: Building advertising for the way people use AI (ChatGPT Ads visual format + measurement)

entries.short_description: Anthropic commits $100M to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by end-2027 via an FDE Residency (in-person sim + 12-week real deployment, badged); first cohorts Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, CBA, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley, Novo Nordisk.
entries.title: Anthropic: Claude Frontier Academy ($100M, 10k Frontier Deployed Engineers)
